name: AccelR8
thesis_text: We accelerate the transition to a decarbonized and resilient economy by investing in catalytic innovations that unlock systems change, faster than climate change. We focus on the most important, most unmet solutions to climate change with an unabashedly market-driven mentality. We systematically map market needs, solutions, and system dynamics to develop high conviction investment theses on industrial end markets. We partner closely with founders to develop products and organizations that win–meticulously shortening feedback cycles starting from early company formation. We collaborate with the most ambitious private, public, and philanthropic partners to advance a shared mission of a climate positive future. We invest in and build companies that transform physical industries. We back solutions that solve acute problems for industrial customers and governments by being cheaper, better, and faster. Specifically, we look for companies that are: Impactful: Demonstrable potential for significant, quantifiable GHG reduction and climate resilience within 20 years. Feasible: Technology proven at TRL 3-4+ with a clear path to scalable, probable deployment and adoption driven by market pull. Economic: Compelling unit economics, validated by robust techno-economic analysis, leveraging capital-efficient models and possessing global economic potential. Formidable: Led by a committed team with the essential technical and commercial expertise. We provide strategic and active partnership from the earliest stages of company formation, preferring to lead pre-seed and seed rounds. Our support is hands-on and focused on shortening market feedback cycles, ruthlessly prioritizing and delivering on milestones, and developing world class talent and organizations.

traction_requirement.notes: Technology proven at TRL 3-4+ with a clear path to scalable, probable deployment and adoption driven by market pull. (https://www.accelr8.com/strategy)

tier1_evidence.stages: We provide strategic and active partnership from the earliest stages of company formation, preferring to lead pre-seed and seed rounds. (https://www.accelr8.com/strategy)
tier1_evidence.sectors: We invest in and build companies that transform physical industries. Specifically, we look for companies that are: Impactful: Demonstrable potential for significant, quantifiable GHG reduction and climate resilience within 20 years. (https://www.accelr8.com/team)
tier1_evidence.check_size: Investment Range $100K - $5.0M, Sweet Spot $1.5M (https://signal.nfx.com/firms/accelr8)
tier1_evidence.geo: We primarily invest in North American-based teams building companies with transformative technology and great execution. (https://www.accelr8.com/strategy)

tier2_evidence.traction_source: Technology proven at TRL 3-4+ with a clear path to scalable, probable deployment and adoption driven by market pull.
tier2_evidence.lead_source: We provide strategic and active partnership from the earliest stages of company formation, preferring to lead pre-seed and seed rounds.

research_notes: AccelR8 is a well-documented climate tech VC fund based in Boston. Founded in 2020 (per CBInsights) or 1982 (per some sources - likely refers to predecessor entity). Confirmed as active investor with 26+ tracked investments. Check size range of $100K-$5M with $1.5M sweet spot confirmed from Signal/NFX. Stages clearly pre-seed and seed focus. Geographic focus is North America with emphasis on Boston/New England. Team includes Dwight Poler (ex-Bain Capital PE partner), Ryan Macpherson (Partner), Louis Kang (Partner with PhD Applied Physics from Harvard), and Megan Phelan (Associate with PhD Materials Science from Caltech). Portfolio heavily weighted toward climate tech, cleantech, materials science, and agriculture tech. No specific ownership target disclosed. Submission process appears to be through website contact form. General email info@accelr8.com confirmed from Crunchbase.

name: NewHealth Ventures
thesis_text: NewHealth Ventures is a forward-thinking investment firm dedicated to driving progress in the healthcare sector by backing transformative ventures that deliver both substantial financial returns and significant human impact. We focus on cutting-edge technologies, including advanced gait analysis systems, genomic workflow solutions, and artificial intelligence-driven diagnostic tools for pathology. Our mission is to empower innovative companies that improve health outcomes and enhance the quality of life, while strategically navigating the complexities of the healthcare landscape. Through our investments, we aim to foster groundbreaking advancements that align with our commitment to improving patient care and outcomes globally. NewHealth invests in companies that not only generate outsized financial returns, but that also drive maximum human impact. Our network of Limited Partners brings to the table deep knowledge of the health ecosystem and unparalleled access to markets and providers, maximizing the strategic return for all stakeholders. We partner with top tier venture capital firms in the United States, Europe and Israel, co-investing in exclusive deals alongside them. It allows us to retain all the economic and representation benefits while investing a fraction of the capital.

name: Healthedge Investment Partners
thesis_text: We see ourselves as stewards of the businesses in which we invest, and as your partner for success. We know that growth is a journey—our team and network have what it takes to help you get there. We have worked across a variety of situations, sub-sectors, and at companies big and small. That means we have the right breadth and depth of experience and expertise that we tailor to the specific needs of our portfolio companies, whatever those may be. Our capabilities extend across areas such as strategic planning, corporate governance, human capital management, cost optimization, supply chain management, product/service line extensions, sales and marketing, channel management, technology, and M&A. Our operating partner team includes leading senior executives from backgrounds across the healthcare continuum. Each of our portfolio companies receives support from a dedicated operating partner resource that becomes an integrated part of their team. Operating partners are matched to a particular portfolio company based on their complementary skillset, experience, and network. These individuals help our portfolio companies unlock transformational value and navigate what it means to be private equity backed. We host an annual summit where our investment team, operating partners, and key portfolio company leaders gather together with subject matter experts to connect, learn, and grow. We believe strongly in the value of shared learning and seek to create development opportunities for our portfolio companies to benefit from each other's perspectives and experiences. When it comes to the use of leverage, we truly take a conservative approach—the same can't be said of many of our industry peers. This affords our portfolio companies more operating flexibility than typical private equity investors. We don't overburden our portfolio companies with debt in order to generate a return. Instead, we seek to create value the old-fashioned way—building businesses by investing in them.

name: Lionheart Ventures
thesis_text: Lionheart Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on the wise development of transformative technologies. Our main areas of investment focus are artificial intelligence and frontier mental health technologies. We believe these sectors are uniquely poised to help bring about a better future for humanity. We invest in exceptional, ethical founders who are developing transformative technologies that have the potential to impact humanity on a meaningful scale, while generating attractive returns for our investors. If we continue to accumulate only power and not wisdom, we will surely destroy ourselves. Carl Sagan. Our methodology: The emergence of advanced AI will be more disruptive than the Industrial Revolution. We invest in the development of AI technologies which defend and enhance human flourishing, agency, and resilience, to help ensure this transition goes well. The current mental health crisis impacts both our quality of life and our ability to collectively make wise decisions for the future. We invest in frontier technologies such as psychedelic medicine and neuromodulation that can dramatically improve the standard of care available today. As former founders, our team has raised money from the world's leading VCs and built companies that have successfully exited. We understand the founder journey from firsthand experience. As a firm, we've narrowed our focus to only the sectors where we can have the greatest impact – AI and frontier mental health. Our network of expert advisors support us in developing intimate understandings of these areas. Guided by our values, we prioritize intellectual honesty, ethical conduct, and counterfactual impact. We aspire to lead conversations around how to responsibly steward humanity's most transformative technologies. We back formidable, ethical, growth-oriented founders addressing multi-billion-dollar markets.

name: Ada Ventures
thesis_text: We co-founded Ada Ventures in 2018 as equal partners and launched the first fund in late 2019, making our first investment in March 2020 as the UK and Europe went into successive Covid lockdowns. When we built the firm we designed every aspect, our internal operations, investment strategy and investment process (sourcing, selecting and supporting) with an inclusive lens. We were convinced that by doing so we would both generate best in class financial returns (alpha) but also build a far more inclusive industry and generate significant positive societal impact, particularly on underserved and vulnerable people in society. This is what we call Inclusive Alpha®, a term we created in October 2023. Ada Ventures was founded on our shared belief that there are people like Ada Lovelace in the world today. These are visionary, talented people whose ideas could positively impact society. However they are undiscovered, unconnected to capital and lack the support to make their ideas a reality. We created Ada Ventures to find those people, to invest in those people and to accelerate their ideas to global success. At Ada, we believe that talent is evenly distributed but, at present, opportunity is not. We also believe that the venture capital industry, at large, is missing a huge opportunity, because it isn't investing in so many groups of talented people. The cult of the 'warm introduction' is a huge problem. Founders that are introduced to investors by friends, school friends and colleagues are thirteen times more likely to receive investment, compared to an entrepreneur who doesn't move in rarefied circles. Great ideas come from places where nobody else is looking and people who are overlooked. These people are the ones who bring new thinking — they are the people who bring pencils when everyone else is using a pen. They have the ability to not be constrained by established ways of operating. Ada Ventures is a fund designed to find and fund the Ada's of today. We focus our capital on three key sectors: climate equity, healthy ageing and economic empowerment. We study demographic shifts, in particular what it means to be human today and in the near future — we're talking five to 10 years. We invest in purpose-led founders building for markets that are large, untapped and growing. Our approach drives outperformance. We call it Inclusive Alpha®.

traction_requirement.notes: Ada invests pre-seed and seed stage. 'We'll invest anything pre-series A. However, we like to invest in companies earlier than others. name: Deep-Tech AI Seed Venture Capital
thesis_text: Neuron Factory was founded in 2023 by scientists, engineers, and investors who believe the most transformative technology companies of the next decade will emerge from deep science, not incremental software iteration. We exist to fund those companies at inception. Our partners bring together decades of experience spanning computational neuroscience, semiconductor R&D, enterprise software, and institutional venture capital. We are operators, researchers, and builders who understand what it takes to turn a research breakthrough into a world-changing product. With a focused portfolio of seed-stage investments and a rigorous technical due diligence process, Neuron Factory has established itself as the partner of choice for founders building at the boundary of what is scientifically possible. Neuron Factory operates at the intersection of fundamental research and commercial application, funding teams with the technical depth to build lasting competitive advantages. We lead pre-seed and seed rounds in deep-tech AI, writing initial checks of $500K to $1.5M and supporting founders from first prototype to product-market fit with dedicated operational resources. Our team includes former ML researchers, semiconductor veterans, and systems engineers who provide hands-on technical guidance alongside capital. We are builders who invest, not analysts who advise. Portfolio companies gain immediate access to our global network of 200+ enterprise partners, academic research labs, and talent pipelines at leading research universities across three continents. Every investment begins with first-principles thinking about technology trajectories. We invest in ideas that are technically credible, scientifically defensible, and commercially transformative. Through partnerships with MIT, Carnegie Mellon, ETH Zurich, and IIT Bombay, we source exceptional founders from the world's best research institutions before they enter the broader startup ecosystem.

name: Healthpointcapital Management, Llc
thesis_text: HealthpointCapital partners with innovators in musculoskeletal healthcare with conviction, focus, and a deep operating mindset. You won't go to the ophthalmologist for arthritis. We don't take our investment focus lightly, either. It's hard to be a generalist investor in a highly specialized field such as healthcare. From implants through novel procedures and biologics to robots and AI-driven surgical navigation, the spectrum of relevant musculoskeletal technologies is broad and nuanced. From CMF and cranial interventions through joint replacement to foot & ankle surgery, ours is an industry rich in innovation and possibilities. Our long-standing passion and focus enables us to curate the best opportunities and execute on them with conviction and flexibility. You bring more than innovation. We know you carry with you the many sleepless nights over patents, regulatory delays, quality issues, study enrollment or sales strategy. We bring more than a check – and we speak your language. From decades of living and breathing musculoskeletal, from the C-suite to the trenches of FDA audits or surgeon labs, we bring the experience, connectivity, and guidance to make those struggles more manageable. Our investment – and our partnership – is there to magnify your achievements. HEALTHPOINTCAPITAL is a values-driven, research-based private equity firm exclusively focused on the musculoskeletal healthcare sector in healthcare on a global basis and manages $800 million of institutional capital. We are the only firm of its kind to focus exclusively on the over $50 billion worldwide musculoskeletal industry including Orthopedics, Dental, Maxillofacial, and Rehabilitation. Our team has extensive medical device operating experience and networks of relationships that can help our portfolio firms and our investors achieve their goals. We endeavor to partner with innovative and exciting emerging businesses and established companies that can benefit from our sector focus, mentorship and investment. We will also seek out established but under-nourished segments and products that are currently owned by major MedTech firms and have the potential to flourish with the addition of HealthpointCapital's musculoskeletal leadership experience and investment.

name: Runway Venture Partners
thesis_text: Runway Venture Partners is a New York City-based early stage venture capital firm focused on investing in post product-market fit SaaS and software-enabled businesses. Runway invests in companies that have put Seed capital to good use and demonstrated visionary entrepreneurial leadership, clear product-market fit and strong growth rates. Our goal is to back industry leaders and help build them into giant companies, starting with a mini-A injection of capital to steepen their growth trajectory now. We think of commerce tech as technologies that improve the efficiency and relevancy of the interaction between buyers and sellers and make the process of value exchange more frictionless and active. While not necessarily a new theme, it is still an exciting and amazingly relevant one: SaaS. Businesses from small and mid-sized to enterprise still deal with massive process inefficiencies and are in need of process optimization. This dynamic moved the goalpost for many well-executing startups preparing for a Series A, as they now had to show higher operating metrics to justify the larger investment. They generally need extra time to mature revenues without compromising growth rate and have to preemptively extend runway in order to approach a large A from a position of strength. In practice, we see startups seeking $2-3M of additional capital to comfortably accomplish this. Securing a lead investor is particularly difficult for a startup at this stage. Part of our strategy is to act as a lead investor and bring additional value by catalyzing the funding round. As investors, we think this stage offers a superior risk-return profile within the venture market. By focusing post product-market fit, we take the biggest risk off the table but invest at a significant discount to the going Series A valuations.

By using AI instead of gut, we fund women and minority founders at a rate 8x higher than the VC industry average. Our process is the same for everyone, no short cuts or warm intros allowed. We have invested in Halifax, Kansas City, Las Vegas, San Diego, and everywhere in between. While we love the Midwest (our home) we believe great companies and founders are everywhere. Our data-driven approach not only removes bias, but it also allows us to invest in founders without ever meeting them in person. At Connetic Ventures, we embrace a data-driven, inclusive, and unbiased approach, setting a new standard in VC. We prioritize objective, data-driven assessments over pitch performances, creating tangible quantitative metrics to evaluate milestones - providing a more reliable basis for decision-making. We challenge optimistic projections, favoring a grounded, data-supported evaluation of market size and competition. We leverage Wendal's quantitative analysis to foster analytical thinking right off the bat and use that data to inform a measured intuitive judgement. This combined approach fosters informed, unbiased investment decisions. We are committed finding, supporting, and investing in startups with the highest growth potential, wherever they may be.

traction_requirement.notes: The initial application takes about 20 minutes, and they will hear back within three business days. Wendal crunches the numbers comparing the information against thousands of data points gathered from successful ventures.

Yamaha Motor Ventures & Laboratory Silicon Valley (YMVSV) exists to accelerate the efforts of teams driving disruptive change. We have the resources and backing of Yamaha Motor Company (Japan), yet the openness and agility of a startup. Promising efforts sometimes raise venture capital. Financing these companies through strategic investment is a portion of our activity. For other ventures, strategic corporate partnerships might mean access to vehicles, technology, teams, hardware, infrastructure, or something else entirely. Whether investment, partnership, or both, we work collaboratively to create the future of industries ranging from personal transportation to industrial automation. With a focus on nine key areas—transportation, robotics, digital health & wellness, fintech/insurtech, data & AI, agriculture, carbon management & removal, energy, and advanced materials—Yamaha Motor Ventures partners with companies looking to transform these industries. YMV's investment strategy prioritizes cross-unit applicable technologies, aiming to enhance efficiency and innovation across diverse business sectors. This shift from industry-specific focuses to functional approaches emphasizes investments in fundamental technologies. Notably, Yamaha prioritizes startups that offer the potential for significant financial returns, aiming for a 10x return on investment. While acknowledging the volatility of certain sectors, the firm emphasizes the importance of avoiding hype-driven investments and maintaining a focus on long-term value creation.

name: 10X Venture Partners
thesis_text: 10X Venture Partners is an operator-led angel investment group focused on early-stage software, AI, and infrastructure companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, the firm is a seed stage (and beyond) investment group that commits operational experience and dollars to portfolio companies. The firm emerged from a group of seasoned entrepreneurs and operators who recognized a gap in the New England startup ecosystem: a lack of accessible, experienced, and hands-on early-stage investors. The founding partners, all with backgrounds in technology, defense, and venture, sought to create a group that would not only provide capital but also leverage their collective operational experience to guide founders. Over time, 10X Venture Partners evolved from a regional angel group into a more structured seed-stage fund, expanding its reach and deepening its sector expertise. Their evolution reflects a commitment to staying close to founders, adapting to market shifts, and supporting innovation across emerging technologies. The firm operates in a casual, open manner with a sense of humor, and is here to mentor founders and get satisfaction in seeing them succeed. Principals, not analysts, work directly with founders, offering candid feedback and strategic guidance. Partners bring real-world experience in tech, defense, cybersecurity, SaaS, and other domains. The firm provides open and direct feedback about businesses whether they invest or not. When they do invest, they get involved—partners have direct operational experience and bring an extensive network of resources to bear to achieve success. Although the firm has a casual atmosphere, this is not a hobby; they invest to make money. The firm focuses its investments across high-growth sectors including mobile, internet, wireless, security, med tech, green tech, SaaS, AI, and fintech, with a strong regional presence in New England. As a certified AWS Startup Partner, 10X Venture Partners provides up to $25,000 in AWS credits and $5,000 in business support to portfolio companies.

name: Better Ventures
thesis_text: Founded in 2011, Better Ventures is one of the original venture capital firms to back technology companies building a better world. We believe that business can be a force for positive change in society and that mission-driven companies have a built-in competitive advantage thanks to the power of purpose. Mission-driven founders have a built-in competitive advantage in raising capital, recruiting and retaining talent, and building a lasting brand thanks to the power of purpose. Backing diverse teams is both a societal imperative and a source of financial outformance. We look for underrepresented founders and aim to build portfolios that are representative of the broader US population. We publish an annual impact report, that measures the progress of our portfolio companies across five key metrics - CO2 emissions avoided, waste reduction, water saved, people served, and quality jobs facilitated. Our founders are leveraging AI, software, biology, and materials science to reshape industries in ways that will benefit both people and planet. Long-emerging trends and breakthroughs in science and technology are beginning to meaningfully reshape healthcare, empowering more consumer agency and accelerating the shift towards a more proactive approach to care. These dynamics point to a massive opportunity — as big as $2T — to build a healthcare system that is more proactive, preventative, and personalized. The Industrial Revolution has propelled economic growth and widespread prosperity for the last 200+ years. But it's left our planet polluted, our climate warming, and our resources depleted. Thankfully a new generation of climate obsessed founders (who care a whole awful lot) are developing novel solutions to dramatically reduce carbon intensity, waste, and pollution across industries. From electrification and biomanufacturing to green chemistry and textile recycling, these solutions are enabling the ideal of economic growth without the externalities.

CCP deeply values these partnerships and believes that strong operators with aligned incentives are the backbone of a successful investment strategy. CCP targets growth equity, leveraged buyouts, and recapitalization transactions in the middle market. The sources of these opportunities are typically derived from private/family-owned businesses seeking liquidity, growth capital, or both – and large corporations seeking to divest non-core assets. CCP's strategy is to deliver more than just capital to management teams by leveraging its relationships and resources to drive internal growth initiatives, operational improvements, and mergers & acquisitions. CCP seeks to partner with management teams in subsectors that have high growth opportunities. The firm takes a collaborative approach to these relationships and believes that strong managers with aligned incentives are the backbone of a successful investment strategy.

name: Why Invest with Nucleation Capital
thesis_text: Nucleation Capital is the first venture fund to focus predominantly on advanced nuclear and is now in its 4th year of full-time fund operations and widely considered the leader. We bring deep technical nuclear knowledge, industry networks and investment expertise to building portfolios of the best ventures operating in this space. We have followed this sector for a long time and are prepared to help investors capitalize on the world's urgent need to phase out fossil fuels with a deep understanding of Gen IV technologies, players and protocols for deploying advanced nuclear energy systems. Whether you want to invest $10,000 or $10,000,000, you've come to the right place. We can help you capitalize on one of the most significant technological disruptions of our lifetime: the transition from fossil fuels to zero-carbon nuclear energy. This isn't just an amazing investment opportunity, it's also the critical pathway for reducing the larger risks posed by climate change to your wealth and life. And, because nuclear provides good jobs and builds GDP, even local governments are motivated to provide attractive incentives which bolsters the private equity in these ventures. Although there are always risks to investing, here the risks of not investing may actually be higher. Nucleation provides investors with boutique access to next-generation nuclear and carbon management innovations in a way that does not create redundancies with most other investments. Our narrow focus means that we do not overlap with either fossil fuel or renewable energy investments. We take a technology, geography and stage-agnostic approach to fill in the gaps in your portfolio—knowing that the winners are not yet known. Additionally, we structure in as much diversification as possible within our narrow thesis, to eliminate as much uncompensated risk as possible, while offering participation at virtually any capital level that works for investors, their assets and risk tolerance. Nucleation Capital lets you invest where the world is going — not where it has been.

name: 5AM Ventures
thesis_text: 5AM was founded in 2002 and pursues investments in advanced life science innovations, and seeks to be diversified across the biopharmaceutical therapeutics, and platform technologies. Within each sector, 5AM invests across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities and evaluates opportunities based on innovative platform technologies, corporate spin-offs and products with shorter development cycles. We strive to maximize shareholder returns for all portfolio companies, unlike many venture capitalists that focus on their best investments. 5AM seeks to redefine business strategy, restructures management teams and accesses additional assets to enhance individual company performance and overall fund returns. Our low loss rates demonstrate our strategy's inherent value and have had a very positive impact on overall returns. 5AM Opportunities Strategy invests in small and mid-cap public and later-stage private biotech and life science companies. At the intersection of life science and venture capital, 5AM is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion as a core principle in catalyzing breakthrough science. By leveraging diverse backgrounds, abilities, and perspectives both in our firm and portfolio, we strive to be leaders in our industry by bravely embracing diversity to enable the development of transformative therapies for ALL patients. Team members draw upon over a century of combined operational experience as CEOs and other leadership roles at life science companies. We believe this positions us as an 'entrepreneur-friendly' firm and validates our taking an active role when mentoring entrepreneurs. We strive to identify the best scientists in leading-edge fields, work with well-established entrepreneurs, and co-invest with value-added venture capitalists and partners at major life science companies. Our investments are expected to generate attractive returns within three to five years driven by validated development-stage assets and by technologies with less regulated commercialization paths. We work to maximize equity returns by sourcing non-equity capital and by creating earlier exit opportunities. This may involve accessing capital from governmental agencies, building strategic alliances with large life science companies or acquiring later-stage products. 5AM's portfolio of advanced life science technologies is diversified within the healthcare industry's biopharmaceutical, drug delivery technology and research instrument sectors. Within each sector, 5AM evaluates innovative platform technologies, corporate spin-offs and products with shorter development cycles and invests across multiple therapeutic areas. 5AM is driven by the 'old-fashioned' VC style of working closely with portfolio companies. Going beyond passive board roles, ours is unusually hands-on when starting companies, assuming short-term operating roles and proactively providing guidance throughout a portfolio company's life. Our team's input to operating plans, strategy and management team development has a major impact on creating and realizing shareholder value. Our professionals have spent their careers in the life science industry, often working together over many years while helping to create shareholder value.

name: Leaders in Clean Energy Investment
thesis_text: Since 2015, CleanCapital has approached the market with a singular focus: to meet the energy needs of businesses, schools, non-profits, and communities with affordable clean energy. Our expertise in small-scale solar and energy storage has resulted in one of the country's largest portfolios of operating solar projects. Today, the energy demands of everyday Americans and American businesses alike are surging as technologies like artificial intelligence continue to advance. CleanCapital develops, constructs, owns and operates, and invests in solar and energy storage projects that put more clean megawatts on the grid, helping to meet energy demands and establish American energy dominance. We know how to canvass the market for quality solar and storage assets and other high-performing investment opportunities. Our deep expertise in the middle market segment enables us to underwrite and diligence those renewable energy portfolios efficiently. Then, we manage them into the future to optimize returns and deliver consistent energy performance for our off-takers and investors. We believe that climate change is the greatest challenge we face. We're committed to doing everything we can to facilitate the transition to renewable energy for the betterment of our planet. We've assembled a team of professionals at the forefront of finance, law, public policy, and project development and construction to forge bold innovations in clean energy investment. Our ESG-aligned approach to climate finance and clean energy development takes all stakeholders into consideration—off-takers, owners, workers, and communities—to ensure equitable outcomes. Since our inception, we have been fully committed to distributed generation (DG)—the 'middle market' between residential and utility-scale that powers commercial and municipal off-takers. As one of the top ten commercial solar asset owners in the nation, our presence in middle market solar and storage continues to grow. Today, in addition to our diverse portfolio of operating assets, we are investing in early-stage development, as well as partnering with developers in emerging and new markets to foster future pipeline opportunities.

name: Sovereign AI Fund
thesis_text: Sovereign AI is the United Kingdom's sovereign venture fund dedicated to scaling British AI companies. We are designed to be different from any previous government-backed unit, acting like a venture capital fund with the muscle of the state behind it – moving fast, backing ambition and cutting through the red tape that so often holds brilliant ideas back. We will invest directly in the UK's most promising AI startups, help them scale quickly, and give them the support they need to compete with the best in the world. We combine equity investment with access to infrastructure, opportunities and wider assets that accelerate growth, from compute to customers. Our goal is simple: help founders scale faster and compete globally, without compromise. We want founders to start in Britain, scale in Britain, and win globally. We will invest in a small number of high-potential sectors which can have a meaningful impact on global GDP, where the UK has a real edge and where Britain can share in your success. We are not a grant-making institution. We are here to invest our resources and capital on a commercial basis. Every decision we make is with the view that the taxpayer should be rewarded for taking a risk and supporting AI companies. We match commercial terms with the world's leading venture firms, working alongside them, and commit to operating with the same pace, passion, risk-appetite and ambition as them as well. Beyond capital, we provide fully funded access to the UK's largest AI supercomputers, with up to 1 million GPU hours available per startup. We offer fast-tracked visas to bring world-class AI talent from anywhere in the world to the companies we invest in. We provide access to the UK's research base, curated national datasets, and awards and contracts of up to £10M.

traction_requirement.notes: No explicit minimum traction stated; fund backs early-stage companies including pre-revenue startups. Focus on founders with ambition and capability rather than revenue milestones.

The fund is structured to build concentrated early ownership in this emerging category, arriving at a moment when humanoids and physical AI are widely viewed as the most transformational technology class of the coming decade.

name: Llama Ventures
thesis_text: Llama Ventures is an early stage venture firm backing ambitious founders building the enduring, AI-native companies of the next decade. The firm maintains a broad investment mandate spanning the entire intelligence stack, from foundational Deeptech Hardware and AI Infrastructure to transformative Vertical SaaS, Healthcare, and Fintech solutions. By providing deep technical expertise and strategic capital, Llama Ventures empowers visionary teams across Consumer AI, Enterprise, EdTech, and Media to transform radical innovation into market-leading reality. Our team brings a mix of investing and operating experience, having partnered with founders as operators, strategists, and early investors. We approach company-building with deep respect for the founder journey and a hands-on mindset—supporting teams through product, go-to-market, hiring, and fundraising. Llama Ventures invests at the earliest stages of company building, from Pre-Seed through Series A. We focus on partnering with founders when conviction matters most—before traction is obvious and when the right support can be transformational. We believe the best returns come from informed, original perspectives—amplified by technology, never replaced by it. We form our views before checking the consensus. True insight lives where most investors aren't looking—and we'd rather be non-consensus and right than safely average. AI handles the noise so we can focus on what matters: understanding founders, markets, and timing. Technology sharpens our process, but every conviction is human. We go deep in the domains we know and stay honest about what we don't. Concentrated expertise leads to better pattern recognition and better decisions. We trust founders to know their business best. Our role is to provide capital, context, and candor—not to second-guess your decisions or flood your inbox. Product strategy, hiring, go-to-market, fundraising—we roll up our sleeves on the problems that matter most at each stage, drawing on our own experience as founders and operators. We connect you with the right engineers, customers, domain experts, and follow-on investors at the right time—not a mass intro list, but targeted introductions that move the needle. Former founders, engineers, and operators — we've been on your side of the table.

name: Starlight Ventures
thesis_text: In venture capital, the team is paramount. We back exceptional founders — people with technical rigor, sound judgment, and the ability to execute through uncertainty. Unstoppable means relentless learning velocity, high agency under constraint, endurance through multi-year adversity, and moral seriousness about the downstream consequences of what is built. Top talent, when given the option, gravitates toward work that matters. Our role is to help the right teams do it faster and with fewer unforced errors. We try to be a thoughtful, steady partner — supportive without being intrusive. In practice, that means underwriting real technical risk early, with clear milestones and intellectual honesty; staying engaged through inflection points as strategy and execution evolve; and bringing the relationships, introductions, and operational judgment that help founders navigate what comes next. Our newest vehicle is evergreen, built so that the horizon of our capital can match the horizon of the work. Alongside our co-investment SPVs, this structure gives us the ability to stay with our best performing companies through the full arc of what they are building. Some of the most important outcomes in frontier tech take time that conventional fund cycles were not designed for. We have been alongside some of our founders for over a decade, through pivots, hard technical milestones, and the kind of scaling challenges that come with building real infrastructure. The duration of those relationships is not incidental. It reflects how we think about the work. We invest in breakthrough science and technology applied to the challenges humanity has no choice but to solve — including the ones we haven't anticipated yet. Space is the clearest example of a compounding stack, where launch, in-orbit infrastructure, sensing, communications, and supply chains reinforce one another. We believe the space economy will be far larger than conventional wisdom assumes, and we back the builders creating the infrastructure and capabilities that make it real. Enablers like next-generation compute, industrial capacity, and critical materials increase the slope of that curve. Resilience is now a competitive advantage and a national necessity. As attacks on physical, digital, and informational systems get faster and cheaper, we back technologies that reduce the asymmetry — by hardening critical infrastructure, strengthening deterrence, and improving recovery.

name: Longitude Capital
thesis_text: Longitude Capital specializes in making venture growth investments in biotechnology, medical technology, and health solutions companies that seek to improve clinical outcomes, enhance patient quality of life, and reduce the cost of care. We invest in both privately held and publicly traded companies through a variety of investment approaches. Since 2006, Longitude Capital has raised over $2 billion across six funds and demonstrated an ability to source, manage, and exit attractive investments across multiple market cycles. Our venture growth strategy is rooted in building a balanced portfolio of clinical-stage and commercial-stage companies with clinically de-risked assets, favorable valuations relative to risk profile, and attractive expected returns within three to five years from initial investment. Longitude Capital seeks to identify new investment opportunities by tapping into our broad network of industry relationships or through the execution of proprietary thematic research into emerging therapeutic areas or industry sub-sectors. We utilize a variety of investment structures, including traditional venture capital, asset spin-outs, recapitalizations, PIPEs, open market purchases, royalties, and other equity and equity-linked instruments. Following an initial investment, we work closely with our portfolio companies and syndicate partners to develop and implement strategic plans, achieve key operating objectives, build world-class teams, raise capital, and pursue liquidity opportunities in a manner that optimizes returns to key stakeholders.

name: Cybernetix Ventures
thesis_text: Cybernetix Ventures is a venture capital firm investing in early-stage robotics, automation, and physical AI startups. Founded in 2021 and led by robotics experts Fady Saad (co-founder of MassRobotics) and Mark Martin (former VP at Analog Devices), the firm believes robotics represents a distinct, nuanced investment asset class with unique dynamics requiring specialized operational insight and sector expertise. The firm's thesis centers on the inevitability of intelligent machines becoming commercially viable through physical AI breakthroughs, and the need for investors who understand robotics' unique challenges and market dynamics differently from traditional software venture investing. Cybernetix invests exclusively in robotics, automation, and physical AI across carefully selected vertical markets: Advanced Manufacturing (factories and production automation), Logistics & Warehousing (order fulfillment, warehouse automation, inventory management), Architecture, Engineering & Construction (construction site automation, surveying, safety), Healthcare & Medical Devices (clinical automation, bioanalysis, medical robotics), Agriculture (precision farming, yield optimization through robotics), and Climate & Sustainability (carbon reduction through automation and robotics solutions). The firm positions robotics as a distinct investment class and actively shapes the category through original playbooks like The Robotics Startup Playbook and its flagship Robotics Invest conference series, while maintaining a reputation as a reality-checking voice that pushes robotics founders on business model rigor with the mantra 'your robot works, but does your business?' Cybernetix has been embedded in the ecosystem for 10 years and thus has an exceptional network of executives, suppliers, customers, manufacturers, acquirers, and growth investors. The team also has extensive technology and vertical markets expertise with hands-on operations and business value creation.

name: Longwood Fund
thesis_text: Longwood Fund is a venture capital firm dedicated to creating and investing in novel healthcare companies that develop important treatments to help patients. The firm's core mission involves identifying groundbreaking scientific discoveries and transforming them into viable companies that develop novel treatments for significant medical challenges. This is achieved by leveraging their deep operating experience and hands-on company-building approach, partnering with world-class entrepreneurs, scientists, and academic innovators. The firm was co-founded by Christoph Westphal and Rich Aldrich, whose extensive pedigree in biotech company creation underpins Longwood's distinctive strategy. Their collective experience, which includes co-founding numerous biotechnology ventures prior to establishing the fund, provided the insight that a more integrated model of company building and investment was needed to translate scientific advancements into patient-benefiting therapies effectively. Longwood Fund often acts as a co-founder or operational partner, deeply involved in company building beyond traditional VC funding. The firm leverages a robust network of leading academic and industry executives, particularly in the Boston biotech hub, to source and support promising healthcare ventures. Longwood Fund takes pride in its value-add investing approach, supporting its companies in accelerating the transition of therapies from the laboratory to the patient. The firm's partners often take on executive roles within portfolio companies, providing strategic guidance and operational support to accelerate the development of new therapies.

name: Investment led by Prime Movers Lab
thesis_text: We invest in breakthrough scientific startups founded by Prime Movers, the inventors who transform billions of lives. We invest in startups reinventing energy, transportation, infrastructure, manufacturing, human augmentation, and agriculture — transforming billions of lives across the world's most important industries. We offer Prime Movers comprehensive resources and integrated coaching to support the transformation of world-class technical experts into extraordinary executives. Our team has developed in-depth academic scientific research, commercialized novel intellectual property, scaled significant enterprises, and mentored renowned scientists on their entrepreneurial journey. We only make a small number of investments so that we can dive deep with every Prime Mover we back and ensure that we create outsized value to dramatically improve the odds of success. We pride ourselves on the fact that the least useful thing we provide is capital. Fundamentally, we don't think of ourselves as being in the venture capital business. We are in the business of helping founders (particularly serial entrepreneurs) build breakthrough scientific startups to transform billions of lives. One of the services we offer to founders is investing capital to fuel growth, but this is just a small aspect of the relationship. We believe that if you supercharge the trajectory of a company's leader, you supercharge the company's trajectory. That begins with selecting founders that value growth and contribution and then focusing our portfolio support on CEO growth including weekly coaching calls with partners, monthly executive coaching, Robbins Research programming, and quarterly management training sessions. We also provide government relations, communications, creative, and technical support. We actually roll up our sleeves and work side by side with our founders to help close customers, hire talent, create marketing materials, raise further financing, establish relationships with government officials, and execute PR opportunities.

name: Uncorrelated Ventures
thesis_text: Uncorrelated Ventures invests in infrastructure software, both traditional and decentralized. The firm's distinctive characteristic is its simultaneous focus on traditional and decentralized infrastructure. While many venture firms chose to specialize in either enterprise software or crypto/blockchain, Uncorrelated embraced both domains. This dual approach allows the firm to identify convergence opportunities and back companies positioned at the intersection of these worlds—a strategic advantage as decentralized technologies increasingly integrate with enterprise systems. Open-source software has become the default foundation for modern technology stacks, and companies that provide tooling, governance, and commercial support around open-source projects occupy defensible market positions. By backing this category systematically, Uncorrelated influences the broader ecosystem's technical direction while capturing value from companies that become essential to enterprise operations. Uncorrelated Ventures has positioned itself as the patient capital provider for infrastructure software—a category that generates durable returns but requires conviction during periods when flashier consumer or enterprise SaaS opportunities capture market attention. By concentrating exclusively on infrastructure software rather than pursuing a generalist approach, Uncorrelated develops deep domain expertise. The firm's investment focus spans enterprise software, developer tools, IoT, AI/ML, and platforms-as-a-service—all categories where infrastructure plays a foundational role. This specialization enables better pattern recognition, stronger founder networks, and more valuable operational support than generalist competitors.

traction_requirement.notes: Invests across seed and early stages; no explicit minimum traction requirement found, but emphasis on technical depth and founder quality

name: AIX Ventures
thesis_text: AIX Ventures is a specialist artificial intelligence venture capital firm founded in 2021 by world-renowned AI researchers and practitioners. The firm is built on the conviction that cutting-edge machine learning research requires hands-on technical diligence that generalist funds cannot provide. With $252 million under management across two funds, AIX has established itself as a leading early-stage investor in AI-native companies, earning the reputation as an 'AI unicorn backer' with breakout positions in companies like Perplexity, Hugging Face, and Weights & Biases. AIX Ventures invests exclusively in 'AI-native' companies—startups where artificial intelligence is the core product and competitive moat, not merely a feature layered onto existing business models. The firm rejects commoditized AI applications and focuses instead on companies building foundational infrastructure, vertical applications with durable advantages, and frontier research that pushes the boundaries of what's possible. At AIX we believe top AI practitioners need to be practicing AI. The firm's focus is on partnering with companies where AI is a core component of the product, spanning sectors like natural language processing, robotics, healthcare, and more. Key sectors include AI infrastructure (e.g., vector databases, model-serving frameworks), vertical AI applications in enterprise productivity, healthcare, climate modeling, robotics, and frontier AI research.

name: AutoTech Ventures
thesis_text: We are a team of experienced entrepreneurs, operators and technologists and investors with a world-class transport community and decades of ground transport experience. With our founder-first philosophy, we invest globally in Seed through series C startups solving ground transport challenges related to connectivity, autonomy, shared-use, electrification, and digitization of enterprise. We're excited about deep-tech, autonomous, AI, and semiconductors, and business model innovations in marketplaces, fintech and SaaS. When we find the right opportunity, we're willing to make an initial investment of $1-$8M as a lead or follow-on investor. Our team has operated within the ground transport and venture capital industries for decades, growing a unique ability to discover and build startups that can complement or disrupt the transport industry. From being involved very early in highly disruptive companies such as Lyft and SpotHero, to spearheading the United States autonomous vehicle policy framework, to helping transport startups raise in excess of $5B and grow their valuations to more than $25B, our team builds on this experience to fuel our thesis on the future of mobility. We understand macro transport trends and daily operations of transport businesses, allowing us to identify not only widely-hyped startup disruptors, but also non-obvious transport market opportunities in niches that require sector expertise. Our deep relationships span most corners of the global ground transport sector. We've gained the backing of many of the largest influencers in this industry from the world's leading fleet operators, dealers, vehicle and semiconductor manufacturers, parts distributors, repair shop chains, telematics service providers, to energy companies. They have entrusted us to identify startups who have the capacity to disrupt and they, in turn, play a critical role in supporting our founders. Furthermore, we've had a focused approach in our investing with an eye towards building a supportive community. From finding that first customer, to cementing that key partnership, to facilitating a strategic acquisition - partnering with transportation industry insiders gives you direct access to such opportunities and more.

name: Breakthrough Energy Ventures
thesis_text: Breakthrough Energy Ventures is a climate-focused investment platform founded by Bill Gates in 2015 that invests across the full spectrum of clean energy innovation. Operating with an exceptionally long 20-year investment horizon and backed by ultra-high-net-worth individuals including Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Jack Ma, and others, Breakthrough Energy Ventures represents the leading global platform for accelerating climate innovation through venture capital and ecosystem support. Breakthrough Energy is built on the conviction that innovation is essential to solving climate change while maintaining prosperity. The firm combines deep technical expertise from former ARPA-E leaders and scientists with access to a broader Breakthrough Energy ecosystem spanning policy advocacy, research, and deployment programs. Their core belief is that superior performance and affordability are prerequisites for global scale—clean technologies must be competitive on cost and reliability to achieve mass adoption. We partner with the world's leading innovators to turn breakthrough technologies into great businesses. Superior performance is our north star—clean technologies have to be affordable and reliable to reach global scale. BEV is committed to investing in companies of all sizes that can bring about environmentally impactful changes in the way our society functions. One of the criteria for investing in technology is its potential to reduce greenhouse gases by at least half a gigaton every year, about 1 percent of global emissions.

traction_requirement.notes: BEV invests in seed-stage, early-stage, and later-stage companies. The fund seeks technologies that can have a substantial impact, aiming for at least half a gigaton reduction in greenhouse gases annually.

Companies driving the adoption curve for emerging technologies by optimizing their cost and performance through development of next-gen hardware and software. Companies driving systems-level change by merging biological science disciplines with hardware and AI/ML technologies. Companies disrupting the status quo in large staple industries by introducing hardware and AI-enabled technologies to drive large-scale productivity improvements. We pride ourselves on being alongside founder's in the ring – not just on the cap table – on the journey to scale. Celesta's core thesis is to do deep tech, which is to really look at the India-US corridor as the place to be. Building businesses is our passion at Celesta. Through our unique mix of extensive operating experience, unrivaled network access, multi-dimensional investment experience, and deep technical expertise, we empower founding teams to develop differentiated technologies and grow globally impactful companies.

name: Construct Capital
thesis_text: Construct Capital is a thesis-driven fund focused exclusively on transforming America's foundational industries—manufacturing, logistics, transportation, energy, defense and critical infrastructure—into "tech-first industrials" that operate more like software companies with higher R&D spending and asset-light models. The fund combines deep industrial expertise with scaled operating experience from companies like Uber, targeting "boring" but massive industrial workflows where modern software and AI are still largely absent, positioning itself as a financial lever for U.S. industrial resilience and competitiveness. The firm's core conviction is that incumbent industrial corporations have become too big to innovate, frozen in operational practices from the 1990s, and that the application of modern software, cloud infrastructure, automation, robotics, and AI to these sectors represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity. Foundational industries have been neglected for decades with chronic underinvestment, creating massive opportunities for tech-enabled disruption. With this comes the potential to unlock unprecedented economic value — 25 years of unrealized opportunity in the largest sectors of the economy — driving both productivity and resilience across critical areas like manufacturing, logistics, and energy. We can close the gap between consumption and production, rebuild domestic capabilities, and restore America's competitive edge on the global stage.

name: DigiTx Partners
thesis_text: At DigiTx Partners, we believe that the pace of change in healthcare will only accelerate in the coming years. We believe that there are many smart people with great insights and drive who are developing innovative technologies and solutions. We look forward to supporting innovative companies that will make a difference in our healthcare ecosystem, from companies that will change how patients navigate the healthcare system, that will integrate the disparate elements that comprise both diagnosis and treatment, that will speed the development of more effective drugs and that will enhance and enable efficient and accurate physician-patient interaction. DigiTx Partners looks forward to investing in those digital health companies that strive to keep all of us in better health. The fund's thesis centers on identifying and supporting innovative founders who are leveraging cutting-edge technology, data analytics, and digital therapeutics to solve fundamental inefficiencies and complex challenges within healthcare and life sciences sectors. The firm believes that the next generation of transformative healthcare companies will be built on data-driven technologies that generate competitive insights and meaningfully enhance patient outcomes. Their investment strategy emphasizes personalized medicine platforms, real-time health data analytics, remote patient monitoring systems, and digital therapeutic solutions. DigiTx Partners believes in the power of patient-focused, data-driven technologies that leverage proprietary or public data to generate competitive insights.

name: EQT Foundation
thesis_text: The EQT Foundation Fund is an evergreen investment vehicle designed to support deep science and pioneering technology with patient, flexible capital. Unlike traditional funds, it operates without fixed timelines, allowing long-term engagement with ventures that require extended development cycles. Structured as a Swedish investment company, it is controlled by Stiftelsen EQT Foundation and capitalized by its Members, who are senior Partners at EQT or Alumni. The Fund invests in solutions that align with EQT's thematic expertise, providing not only capital but also strategic insights, industry networks, and scaling support. In climate and nature, we prioritize technologies that contribute to Net Zero by 2050 or significantly reduce biodiversity loss. In health and wellbeing, we seek innovations that either reach large underserved populations or deeply impact specific medical challenges, with a strong focus on deep tech solutions. Climate investments are guided by The Climate Brick, a structured manual for scaling climate tech solutions, while health investments are evaluated through tailored frameworks informed by EQT Life Sciences expertise. The EQT Foundation Fund provides strategic support, industry expertise, and access to the EQT network. We match portfolio companies with dedicated deal teams comprising EQT professionals with sector-specific knowledge. These teams work closely with founders to navigate scaling challenges, refine strategies, and secure key partnerships. Our companies also benefit from the global EQT network, including over 500 Industrial Advisors and 300+ EQT portfolio companies, offering valuable connections and mentorship. By combining capital, expertise, and strategic partnerships, we help climate and health innovators turn bold ideas into market ready solutions that can potentially drive meaningful change.

name: Energy Impact Partners
thesis_text: Fifth Wall aims to drive value and accelerate growth for our partners and entrepreneurs through access to innovative technologies, strategic insights into emerging trends, and the unrivaled scalability of our network of corporations and changemakers. We designed our platform to technologize the spaces around us. Whether that means making buildings smarter, safer, more energy efficient, or all of the above, the outcome is the same: we fund cutting-edge technologies and companies that are committed to future-proofing the spaces in which we live, work, and play. Fifth Wall pioneered a strategic LP network of 110+ large global real estate owner-operators who invest in the funds and then become structured distribution channels and customers for portfolio companies. The founding team's hybrid DNA—Brendan Wallace's background in Blackstone real estate and founding/selling a tech startup plus co-founding Cabify, and Brad Greiwe's role in co-founding Invitation Homes, the $6.7B single-family rental platform—gives the firm uncommon credibility with both global property owners and high-growth tech founders. Real estate is kind of this massive industry when it comes to climate change, but at the same time we haven't seen the industry commit a significant amount of capital to the tech that's required to decarbonize it. In 2022, Fifth Wall announced its inaugural Climate Tech Fund, a sustainability venture fund investing in technologies that would decarbonize the real estate industry, which drives an estimated 39% of global emissions. The fund is focused on technologies related to energy efficiency, water reuse, decarbonization, climate resilience and risk management.

name: First AI-Only VC Fund
thesis_text: We turn the art of investing into science through AI and build an AI-only portfolio since 2017. Vela is essentially an AI startup investing in other AI startups. We are obsessed with disrupting this game. We will make VC advice, expertise and guidance a commodity through continuous pursuit of research in artificial general intelligence focused on venture capital. We are building products to scale our networks and expertise with a simple goal: help all entrepreneurs have an accessible and 7/24 available VC assistant. We will find and fund the best entrepreneurs faster than anybody else. As early investors, the founder matters more than anything else to us. If we are convinced about the founder's quality and attributes, the technology, product and the market are secondary. Of course, the more progress the startup has, the more traction there is to look at, so we do analyze the product, traction or metrics if there are any. One of the attributes that differentiate Vela is the fact that it is the first AI-native and product-led VC firm in the world. We have a world-class research program with the University of Oxford. We receive 30 interns from this institution every year. We carry out and publish our research in collaboration with the University of Oxford.

name: Google Ventures
thesis_text: In 2008, Google's founders asked, "What would it look like to create a radically different kind of venture fund?" It would need to have the reliability of a single LP, the autonomy of a traditional VC, and the technical expertise of a founder. It would need access to Google's people, products, global reputation, and the freedom to invest in direct competitors. Launched as Google Ventures in 2009, GV originated as an independent venture capital firm for innovative founders, and today we're formally known as GV. With Alphabet as our sole limited partner, we focus all our energy on meeting and supporting founders at every stage of company-building. Our operating partners support founding teams across executive talent, communications, and marketing. We also connect startups with Google and Alphabet companies, providing unique access to the world's best technology and talent. We got into venture capital for the venture (and the adventure) — to help founders take on the world's biggest challenges, knowing that part of their preparation requires capital. But it also requires the right mindset, building the right team, developing the right product, and picking a partner for the journey with the know-how to give support and space to grow and learn. While finding capital may be more accessible than ever, the venture part of VC is still hard. Building a company that spans generations and creates far-reaching, equitable change is still insanely hard. We hope the most reliable piece of the whole journey is the relationship with us. We invest in innovative founders across industries and optimize for ideas that demand long-term relationships — ones where we can provide value across multiple stages and milestones.

name: Khosla Ventures
thesis_text: Khosla Ventures is a techno-optimist investor fundamentally focused on technology-based economic disruption of large markets. Founded by Sun Microsystems founder Vinod Khosla, the firm explicitly seeks "black swan" opportunities—high-impact innovations that appear contrarian or impossible to most of the market. The firm operates with a philosophy of "venture assistance" rather than just capital deployment, providing strategic guidance, operational support, and leveraging its extensive portfolio network to help founders build category-defining companies. The firm's core belief is that technology and innovation can solve the world's largest problems. They tolerate approximately 70% failure rates in exchange for backing capital-intensive, science-heavy bets in climate, healthcare, and deep-tech. KV's investment approach is fundamentally contrarian: they seek unfair advantages through proprietary technology, business model innovations, and exceptional founding teams with domain expertise. Khosla Ventures invests across eight primary sectors with equal conviction: Consumer & Retail (bold companies disrupting consumer markets and daily habits through technology, including OpenAI, DoorDash, Eight Sleep, and Instacart); Enterprise Software (AI-driven enterprise solutions, developer tools, and infrastructure, including Replit, GitLab, Nutanix, and Cognition Labs); Fintech & Payments (financial infrastructure and payments innovation, including Stripe, Block, Affirm, and Ramp); Healthcare & Digital Health; Biotech & Life Sciences; Climate & Clean Energy; Robotics & Automation; and Semiconductors & Hardware. Beyond capital, KV provides active operational support and company-building expertise from experienced operators, access to deep portfolio network for recruiting, customers, and partnerships, strategic advice and board-level guidance, and direct founder feedback based on experience emphasizing "brutal honesty, not hypocritical politeness."

name: Led by Cycle Capital
thesis_text: The Circular Innovation Fund (CIF) is a global growth-stage venture capital fund focused exclusively on circular innovation, striving to positively contribute to climate change mitigation and the circular use of resources. Led by Cycle Capital and Demeter – a team of financial entrepreneurs with years of cleantech-focused capital management experience – the fund's mission is to accelerate the growth of circular innovation, close the loop on single-use waste and re-design our economy for a more sustainable future. Acknowledging the increasing pressure on natural resources and the global waste crisis, Circular Innovation Fund invests in growth-stage companies across North America, Europe and Asia, which have the potential to solve complex problems along the supply chain and minimize environmental impact. These companies bring forward breakthrough technologies and business models within the circular economy, including new materials, circular packaging, recycling and waste innovations, logistics and distribution, clean technologies, eco-efficient processes, and circular business models. CIF invests in growth-stage companies that are innovating within the circular economy, specifically targeting sectors that address complex supply chain issues. The fund emphasizes breakthrough technologies and business models that contribute to sustainability and climate change mitigation. The fund's robust, reliable and innovative impact measurement methodology integrates due diligence and continued monitoring on critical non-financial KPIs including greenhouse gas emissions reductions, resource use and diversity over the investment horizons of portfolio companies. CIF is an impact innovation fund classified as Article 9 under the EU's Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation.

name: Marque Ventures
thesis_text: Marque Ventures was purpose-built to capitalize on emerging opportunities in defense. Proprietary due diligence and deal flow models derived from decades inside the halls of government combined with a passion for matching cutting-edge capabilities to the needs of American warfighters gives us a sustainable advantage for driving investment returns and makes us the partner-of-choice for entrepreneurs seeking to accelerate their growth in the national security market. The U.S. Department of Defense seeded the companies that built our present creating Silicon Valley and the modern venture capital industry - the internet, touchscreen interfaces, and GPS navigation all came out of federally funded labs. Today, "The Valley of Death" - the delay between finding product market fit and generating revenue caused by the defense budgeting process makes investing in early-stage defense companies too risky for most VCs. We believe this is a problem worth solving, so we are rebuilding bridges between DoD and private industry - investing in companies with defense use-cases and supporting them at every stage of their journey. Marque Ventures was founded by the same team brought in to revitalize the Congressionally-funded Army Venture Capital Corporation (AVCC) - the Department of Defense's version of In-Q-Tel. In a similar vein, Marque Ventures is engaging private capital to support national security objectives by bringing cutting-edge technology to the Department of Defense (DoD) and generating exceptional returns to our investors.

name: One Mind Accelerator
thesis_text: The One Mind Accelerator backs bold and determined founders of early-stage startups with the network, education and capital to build category-defining companies that radically improve the lives of people facing mental health challenges. Launched in 2023, the highly competitive program selects a cohort of 10-15 startups each year from hundreds of applicants. The companies span care model innovations to diagnostics and treatments, and are prioritized for serious mental illness, youth mental health, maternal mental health, and precision psychiatry. Designed from the ground up with a specific focus on mental health, the selected founders participate in ten weeks of programming, with in-person opening and closing weeks in Menlo Park, CA. The program leverages One Mind's vast and influential network of leaders and domain experts to help the startups take their innovations to market faster and with greater impact for people facing mental illness. Supported by leading philanthropists and corporations, the One Mind Accelerator seeks to usher in a new era of value-based, affordable, accessible, equitable and personalized mental healthcare. The 10-week intensive hybrid program blends cohort-based and ultra-customized, milestone-driven programming to help founders fast-track company building. Participants receive advice, guidance, and coaching from a 300+ mentor network, with the domain expertise, experience, and connections to fast-track company building. They receive warm introductions to world-class investors, coaching to raise their next round, and grant-support to raise from non-dilutive sources. Companies leverage facilitated meetings with payors, providers, employers, academic medical centers, etc., to secure deals and strategic partnerships to validate product and market. Founders elevate their leadership skills, cultivate peak performance, and build their personal and company brand through 1:1 coaching, workshops, and thought leadership opportunities.

The firm believes that this "prepared mind" approach best equips the firm's team to respond quickly when opportunities arise for Questa and the firm's portfolio companies. The firm believes that technology will be both an enabler of efficiency and a catalyst for growth in all the businesses in which the firm invests. For the firm's services companies, technology will be an optimizer of care delivery. For the firm's digital health companies, technology will enable new service offerings promising better clinical outcomes at lower cost. For medical device companies, technology protected by significant intellectual property will underpin their key products and form the basis for their competitive advantage. While science and technology are constantly improving the quality of healthcare, patients still struggle to navigate the complex system and select their optimal care. The firm believes a patient-centric mindset will continue to grow in importance as patients engage more deeply in their care and more actively evaluate their healthcare options as consumers. As a result, the firm seeks to invest in companies focused on providing better patient care and improved quality-of-life at a lower overall cost to the healthcare system.

name: Salesforce Ventures
thesis_text: Salesforce Ventures was launched as Salesforce's venture arm in 2009. Salesforce is the sole source of capital for Salesforce Ventures, and our mandate is to partner with best-in-class entrepreneurs and generate top returns. We believe innovation can come from anywhere. This is why we invest across the U.S., Europe, Israel, Japan, Korea, India, and Australia. Our global reach allows us to partner with visionary entrepreneurs from diverse markets, helping them unlock opportunities on an international scale. Our strategy is simple: we leverage our decades of expertise in the cloud and our deep, long-term relationships with key decision-makers at thousands of businesses worldwide to give you a unique advantage. Salesforce Ventures is a VC dedicated to partnering with best-in-class entrepreneurs across the enterprise technology ecosystem. We provide enterprising founders with patient capital, coveted community, and privileged access to the resources they need to build industry-defining companies. We invest globally in enterprise software companies that we believe will be the next generation of industry leaders. Our core investment areas are data and infrastructure, security, generative AI, horizontal SaaS, industry verticals, and impact (i.e., climate tech, edtech, health tech, and financial inclusion). We do not generally invest in consumer software or hardware. We aim to support founders at all stages of the company-building lifecycle, from seed funding through the growth stage. Our investments range from < $5M for seed rounds to $50M+ for growth-stage rounds. Our investment process is designed to be founder-friendly and align with the fast-moving VC landscape. With patient capital and the flexibility of an evergreen funding model, we're capable of investing at any stage and supporting our entrepreneurs and their companies through future stages of growth. Our goal is a quick and straightforward process, so you can spend less time fundraising and more time building. Salesforce Ventures doesn't aim to make a quick return on our investments; we think in years and decades, not quarters. We believe that great companies can be built in any market cycle, but true innovation and outlier results require patience and commitment. We aim to partner with companies that will stand the test of time.

name: Slow Ventures
thesis_text: Slow Ventures rejects the factory model of venture investing that prioritized rapid capital deployment over fundamentals. Instead, Slow focuses on identifying genuine venture moments — discrete inflection points where new capital can validate novel hypotheses and materially advance a business. The firm's core thesis centers on backing experienced founders with deep domain expertise and genuine conviction. They seek founders who have spent 5-10-20 years developing expertise and understanding market gaps, for whom starting a company represents serious commitment — walking away from substantial salaries and established networks. Slow Ventures leads seed and pre-seed rounds with capital funding rapid experimentation with significant, demonstrable results testing specific, high-stakes assumptions. Their three core requirements for investment are: (1) the capital funds experimentation testing a novel risk or hypothesis, (2) where validation dramatically increases business value, and (3) that cannot be funded another way. The firm emphasizes being flexible on round construction and company structure, willing to move slowly when appropriate and fast when necessary. Slow is unapologetically generalist, investing across SaaS, fintech, crypto, healthcare, and newer categories like the creator economy. A generalist strategy only works if the fund is extremely disciplined about what it is looking for. Pattern matching across verticals, across business models, and across founders requires a tight buy box and clear internal metrics. Slow Ventures invests in entrepreneurs and inventors central to the technology industry and those who are leading on the edges of science, society, and culture. With a community built on collective experience and fueled by curiosity, Slow understands the entrepreneurial journey. Investing at the center of technology and on the edges of science, society, and culture, Slow gives curious founders the resources, connections, experiences, and empathy required to build strong, sustainable companies.
