name: Droia Ventures
thesis_text: Droia invests globally in young drug development companies that use novel science and innovative approaches to bring promising therapies to patients. We are specialists, investing exclusively in therapeutics for oncology and genetic disease. Our focus and our in-house team of drug development experts and biotech professionals allow us to accelerate our companies' progress by actively supporting them from company creation through clinical proof of concept. We are hands-on investors and entrepreneurs, fully dedicated to making an impact and saving patient lives. For biotech companies, ultimate success is measured in effective patient benefit. Promising therapies should have a material impact on patient prognosis, measured as a function of the severity of the unmet medical need addressed and the improvement in therapeutic benefits as compared to (expected) standard of care. Droia actively scouts for the best science and the best teams. Whether investing in an existing company or creating a new company, we actively participate in our portfolio companies' development. thesis_text: We invest at the intersection of technological innovation and cultural shifts, backing founders building category-defining consumer technology companies. As the world becomes more complex, consumers are looking for more than access — they want clarity, curation, and connected experiences. Whether through intelligent systems, adaptive marketplaces, or trust-driven infrastructure, we seek businesses that fuel personal agency and create new efficiencies at scale. Our investment focus is not static; it evolves as new opportunities emerge. What remains constant is our belief that category-defining businesses are built by founders who see what others don't, act with conviction, and execute with precision. We back teams who can build, not just theorize—founders and operators who understand the software, systems, and infrastructure required to bring their vision to life. The best founders are intellectually honest, adaptive, and relentless. They operate with conviction but aren't rigid; they adjust, refine, and evolve in pursuit of something enduring. At Forerunner, partnership isn't transactional — it's immersive. Partnering with Forerunner means having relentless advocates fully bought into your journey. We take the long view, knowing that building dominant market positions requires time and persistence. We understand that the most important companies of tomorrow may look unusual, unexpected, and even undefined today. As early believers and often first investors, we commit $1-15M as initial investments to founders building superior technologies, products, and services positioned to scale and dominate their categories. We invest with conviction, flexibility, and long-term commitment. Our approach is designed to support founders at critical inflection points, ensuring they have the capital, strategic guidance, and network to build enduring consumer technology businesses. We primarily make initial investments at Seed and Series A, the moments when ambition meets execution — when a founder's vision is taking shape, and the foundation for scale is being laid. While our primary focus is early-stage, we remain opportunistic and thesis-driven, selectively making later-stage investments when we see a company at a pivotal moment for the next stage of breakout growth. At every stage, our investment philosophy remains the same: we back companies that are reshaping industries, founders who think expansively and execute relentlessly, and businesses that are built not just to grow, but to lead.

name: Impact VC
thesis_text: Impact Venture Capital seeks to back early-stage companies, strictly. With early stage, seed and Series A rounds you have the most uncertainty and risk there. But if you actively manage the companies and the portfolio itself, you will realize the greatest returns. All the data from Cambridge, and others, bears this out. When you look back over the decades, the top performing returns come from early-stage firms by and large. This stage is also where you can provide the real business development part of venture, as opposed to just writing checks and staying largely on the sidelines. Impact VC has an interest in startups developing new technology that can cut across multiple customer verticals. The firm will make investments alongside corporate venture groups in early stage information technology startups, with a focus on software and data analytics, and a commitment to serving one of four global challenges: security and government; energy and transportation; agriculture and health; and education and media. The firm differentiates itself with its close ties to corporate venture groups and the accelerator it operates. We really understand how corporates work, how their venture groups work, and how we can provide value to them. We believe that there are extraordinary opportunities to build out syndicates with corporates who add value well beyond capital. When the firm says impact, it's not about a double or triple-bottom line, but pure financial returns.

We believe applying breakthrough technologies to these foundational industries is how we unlock commercial growth, strengthen national security, and drive lasting transformation. name: Attack Capital
thesis_text: Attack Capital was born from a simple observation: the traditional venture capital model is broken for early-stage AI companies. Great ideas are lost in pitch decks, and brilliant founders are forced to spend more time fundraising than building. We knew there had to be a better way. As a YC-backed AI venture studio, we are redefining how AI companies are created, funded, and scaled. Our journey began as founders in Y Combinator's Winter 2022 batch. Surrounded by the brightest minds in technology, we experienced firsthand the power of intense focus, rapid iteration, and a community dedicated to building great things. We saw how the YC model transformed promising ideas into world-changing companies. However, we also saw a critical gap in the ecosystem. While YC excels at accelerating existing startups, many brilliant founders and transformative AI ideas never even reach the starting line. We founded Attack Capital to solve this problem. We combined the operational intensity of Y Combinator with the strategic resources of a venture fund to create a new kind of organization: an AI venture studio that systematically builds companies from the ground up. Our mission is to build the next generation of market-defining vertical SaaS companies, powered by artificial intelligence. We believe that AI is a general-purpose technology that will reshape every industry on the planet. By focusing on specific verticals, from healthcare and legal to finance and manufacturing, we can build targeted, high-impact AI solutions that solve real-world problems. We are not passive investors. We are builders, operators, and co-founders who are deeply involved in every aspect of company creation. Our success is measured not by the number of companies we fund, but by the number of successful, enduring businesses we help create.

Kiko Ventures, launched by IP Group, is an evergreen climate tech fund. As an evergreen platform without a fixed 10-year investment mandate, Kiko Ventures can be a highly flexible investor, able to do what's required. name: Kiloton Fund
thesis_text: AirMiners developed this pioneering financing model after realizing that the biggest challenge carbon removal projects currently face is obtaining initial funding. The Kiloton Fund buys carbon credits from startups at a discount. This approach provides immediate revenue for the startups, fueling their operations. Simultaneously, it creates a compelling opportunity for investors when the credits are sold at full price later. It's a new funding model that AirMiners is piloting to complement equity investments—critical at a time when capital is getting scarcer and the world needs more innovations to succeed. The learnings will lay the groundwork for a larger Megaton Fund, designed for even greater impact. Their fundamental belief: "Climate is everything." The firm backs visionaries accelerating climate innovation that will reshape the global economy while delivering venture-scale returns. Prelude's approach emphasizes two core principles: "Screen for impact, invest for scale" and "The best ideas come from everywhere." thesis_text: The Rockies Space Fund is an early-stage venture capital fund based in Colorado, focusing on aerospace startups. name: SolarWind III
thesis_text: The Taaleri SolarWind III Fund has a value-add investment strategy to acquire, develop, contract, construct, operate and exit a portfolio of utility-scale onshore wind farms, solar parks and battery energy storage assets. The Fund's main target markets are the Nordics, the Baltics, Poland, Southeast Europe and Spain, with selective investments in the United States (Texas). The renewable energy power and storage plants that the Fund will construct will generate green electricity for around 1.3 million households, reduce an estimated 2.3 million tonnes of carbon dioxide, reduce air pollution, improve grid infrastructure, create local employment, generate local and state tax revenues and increase energy security. This Fund is a financial product, classified as an Article 9 product according to EU SFDR Regulation (2019/2088) and has an objective of making sustainable investments. The Fund benefits from support from the European Union under the InvestEU Fund. The Fund's strategy is to invest only in activities that make it possible to reduce or avoid CO2 emissions or to balance the electricity grid or electricity distribution by establishing the energy infrastructure required for enabling the decarbonisation of energy systems. Target companies commit to setting and implementing science-based emission reduction plans to achieve net zero emissions by 2030.

name: The Wing Manifesto
thesis_text: Wing is an extremely focused venture firm that helps to build billion-dollar companies in the business technology markets. We are company builders. We are not portfolio managers. We limit the number of investments we make so that we can dedicate our resources to the success of each. We also limit our investments to a select few categories where we have deep experience and relationships and see the potential to build consequential companies that are category-defining. We believe that it's a great time to build a business technology company. Data, Mobile and Cloud are driving a wave of change at a scale that we see only once in a generation. It is bigger than anything we've seen before and creates massive potential for innovators with great ideas. We look forward to working with founders and their early teams to lead this change and build companies that matter. Wing is focused on active early-stage investing where our opportunity for impact is the greatest. We commit to our teams with a Series A or seed investment, and remain deeply engaged throughout the life of the company. Depth of experience and difference-making relationships are at the core of the work we do, so Wing maintains an exclusive focus on business markets where we have strong, reinforcing knowledge and networks. The Wing Method is the manner in which we engage deeply with our early-stage companies, helping talented founders set the foundation upon which to build an enduring business technology company. The underpinning is a thoughtful, craftsmanship approach, nailing key foundational issues before scaling a startup. The concept of Product / Market Fit lies at the heart of the Wing Method. The centerpiece of our strategy is our proprietary Wing Network, a large community of trusted relationships amongst the key buyers and users in our target market segments. We make extensive use of our Wing Network to help teams test and validate their company's value proposition, product definition and go-to-market strategies.

name: Ub Figg
thesis_text: UB FIGG is a private equity fund investing in innovative growth companies accelerating the use of renewable bio-based materials. We focus on the packaging, building products and biochemicals industries. The first UB FIGG fund started its operation in January 2023 and has EUR 114 million in commitments. The fund has a pan-European investment scope and can invest EUR 5-20 million per portfolio company. UB FIGG's Partners and Advisory Board consist of highly experienced experts in the forest industry, corporate finance and growth entrepreneurship. Through its investments, the fund helps the bio-based industries to create solutions to mitigate climate change. UB FIGG is a signatory of Operating Principles for Impact Management and reports on the environmental and climate impact of its investments. The UB FIGG organisation has an in depth understanding of the renewable bio-based industries. The fund management team, investment committee and advisory board have extensive and comprehensive global sector expertise on the entire biomaterials industry cluster with over 300 years of combined industry experience. The fund's central theme is replacing fossil-based materials with bio-based alternatives. Everything that's made from fossils today can be made from wood tomorrow. A potential portfolio company needs to be far enough in terms of the so-called technical readiness level (TRL). The minimum TRL is 6-7. To give an example, a manufacturing company has to have conducted a successful pilot before we can consider an investment. We can also invest in more mature companies as long as there is a strong growth element involved. It is also vital that these companies already have commercial traction, i.e. adequate market acceptance and are already in a growth phase, towards scaling up to an industrial level.

traction_requirement.notes: Companies must have commercial traction, adequate market acceptance, and be in growth phase towards scaling to industrial level. Minimum Technical Readiness Level (TRL) 6-7 required; manufacturing companies must have conducted successful pilot.

We look for startups that have a clear product-market fit with their initial offerings. Traction isn't just about revenue; it's about having a growing customer base, strategic partnerships, and evidence of demand for their solution. A high technology-readiness level isn't always a prerequisite as we have the technical experience in the team needed to validate technical concepts even pre-demonstration, and hence reduce our investment risk. We seek realistic valuations that reflect both the current state of the venture and its future potential. We avoid crowded and much-hyped investment rounds, focusing instead on those where our investment can catalyze significant growth. We are very much aligned with what SpaceX has done, and we are investing in the wake of it. SpaceX has opened up a huge satellite sector, so you look at our portfolio, you see component builders, you see satellite builders, really people who are benefiting from SpaceX. We are staying away from the really long-term stuff, and we are probably staying away from direct competition to the 800-pound gorilla in the room, which is SpaceX.

name: Lowercarbon Capital
thesis_text: Lowercarbon Capital backs kickass companies that make real money slashing CO₂ emissions, sucking carbon out of the sky, and buying us time to unfuck the planet. Bless the activists, but we see a different path towards a brighter (and cooler) future. Shame and guilt won't get us there, markets will. To be clear, this isn't charity. Fixing the planet is just good business. We'll write your first check and are set up to keep investing deep into the alphabet as your company grows. So if you're building a startup to rein in global warming while making cold, hard cash, drop us a line. The firm takes a uniquely broad approach to climate investing across three buckets—"Slashing new CO2," "Sucking up carbon," and "Buying more time"—while also funding nonprofit research initiatives through a separate pool of capital when the science is critical but the business model is unclear. The firm specializes in leading deep-tech and hardware-heavy climate deals that many VCs avoid, leveraging in-house scientific expertise to underwrite advanced science in fusion, novel cement, grid technologies, and more, with a highly engaged "company-builder" style where partners routinely help with technical decisions, recruit heads of science, and secure regulatory approvals. Lowercarbon requires every investment to deliver both gigaton-scale carbon impact and substantial financial returns. The new markets Lowercarbon Capital is most excited about involve hard-to-decarbonize sectors such as heavy-duty transportation, chemicals, building materials, and energy production. The firm is also seeing big transformations underway in electricity production, recycling, plastics, fertilizer, and protein.

name: Counteract
thesis_text: Counteract backs early stage founders fostering innovation in carbon removal. Counteract One, our first fund, aims to catalyse 5Gt of C02e removal by 2050 through pre-seed and seed stage investments in solutions that are additive to the ecosystem. We offer engineer and scientist entrepreneurs the financial and strategic support to turn fresh ideas into self-sustaining businesses with the potential to capture or store greenhouse gases at global scale. Our focus is on the earliest stage of a company's life - research, prototyping, market development - to prove new theories and unlock new pathways in this vital space. We invest in all fields of emissions removal technology, including (but not limited to) enhanced weathering, blue and soil carbon, direct air capture, afforestation/reforestation and sequestration. Responsible, regenerative pathways. We won't allow carbon removal to excuse avoidable emissions and we prize other environmental and social benefits. Note that we don't currently invest in project development, later stage or decarbonisation efforts outside CO2 and other greenhouse gas removal. Every lever will be needed so we invest across the spectrum of novel and conventional solutions.

name: Newfund Capital
thesis_text: We invest in what is good for both people and the planet. This goes with permanent reinvention. We help startups grow stronger through opportunities to scale, network, and succeed. Newfund's investment philosophy is very focused on passion, commitment, team dynamics, capacity to execute, and the understanding that the expected value of a startup is negative. Despite this, founders are compelled because of a vision, unique insight into a market, and passion about solving a problem. Once there is conviction on founder-market fit, Newfund then looks at the product and the market to define whether or not there is a venture opportunity. The firm emphasizes that investment is an accelerant, but not a solution—the team must iterate faster, find product-market fit, and be able to grow quickly. Newfund was created by and for founders, with its LP base primarily consisting of entrepreneurs and business leaders, reflecting its founder-centric philosophy. The firm provides not only financial support but also strategic guidance and access to a network of entrepreneurs and industry experts. Newfund has developed a strong culture centered around entrepreneurship and encourages initiatives to support the ambitions and development of its portfolio companies.

MPower Partners will leverage its extensive global expertise and network to support startups' ESG integration, business scaling and global expansion, as well as facilitate overseas startups' entry into Japan.
